k-november.title: GTA VI launch memecoins
k-november.sourceSays: Posts say GTA VI launches Nov 19 and a wave of GTA/Vice City themed Solana memecoins formed; one account says Rockstar has no official coin, and an outlet cites $58M 7-day volume for 23 such tokens.
k-november.reason: The VICE 6 / PROJECT VICE 6 coins (Vice VI, November 19) ride the GTA VI release-date meta; e1 only showed call-group posts but e2 posts of Nov 14-18 describe the story. Unofficial per posts.
